create_A2C_instance: create an A2C instance with config, create_env, and create_agent functions for reinforcement learning
run_A2C_training: run the A2C training loop with evaluation and logging until the time limit is reached
compute_A2C_loss: compute the critic loss, A2C loss, and entropy loss from trajectories using get_loss method
setup_evaluation_batcher: setup an S_EpisodeBatcher for evaluating agent performance in deterministic mode during training
setup_training_batcher: setup an S_Batcher for sampling trajectory pieces across multiple threads and environments
